text:
Sam: Quick poll — does anyone else feel like the thermostat is secretly running a coup? :cold_face:
Lina: Yes. I have strong opinions. It is biased toward arctic engineers. :snowflake:
Priya: Proposing a Thermostat Treaty. Agenda: agreed office temp range, emergency hot/coffee clause, and mandatory seasonal sweater days.
Marcus: Love the treaty. Also proposing we appoint an official guardian for Earl the Paperclip (found him under the printer). Does he get an office chair? :paperclip:
Nora: Earl deserves ceremonial duties. He will be listed in the treaty: "Earl shall be consulted on all decisions involving humidity and poor printer behavior."
Sam: Ok treaty draft items: 1) Temp window 69-72F 2) Hot drink clause: if someone brings hot soup, thermostat may be lowered by 3 degrees for 30 minutes 3) Earl gets a tiny nameplate on the supply shelf
Lina: 69-72 is fair. Also adding: if thermostat gets set above 74 by accident, offender brings pastries the next day. :croissant:
Priya: Love pastries enforcement. Also, can FacilitiesBot add a dummy calendar event called "Thermostat Council" every Monday for quick gripe airing?
FacilitiesBot: Event created: "Thermostat Council" recurring Mondays 10:00. (Created by FacilitiesBot)
Marcus: Photo evidence rule: if you change the temp manually, you must post a selfie with a sticker that says "Temp Czar" for one week.
Nora: New hires should get a tiny Earl pin during onboarding and recite the one-line oath: "I acknowledge Earl, and will not unplug the router." Short and meaningful.
Sam: Committee volunteers to finalize treaty language? Lina and Priya?
Lina: I'm in. I'll draft a two-sentence version for the handbook.
Priya: Happy to proof. Also making a small flyer for the kitchen: "Earl and the Thermostat Treaty: Respect the Balance."
Marcus: Can we get enamel pins? Small cost but huge lore value.
FacilitiesBot: Reminder set: "Submit treaty draft" in 3 days. (Reminder created by FacilitiesBot)
Nora: Ritual idea: At each all-hands, we show a 3-second clip of Earl approving or disapproving via emoji overlay. Low-effort, high lore.
Sam: Agreed. Low-effort lore is best lore. Meeting adjourned. Treaty draft incoming. :gavel:
